body.message:
Hello Elena,

For this 1-bedroom Upside unit, we can offer you the same rate of AED 6,000 until August only. If you wish to extend beyond that, the rate will be AED 7,000, and thereafter it will be subject to market rates on a monthly basis.

For now, we can confirm AED 6,000 for Upside until August. Please also note that a security deposit of AED 3,000 is applicable.
